_governance: Declarative data only. Judge authority is owned by eval pipeline, not apps_rg.

timeout_policy.note: Judge timeout on a required dimension is treated as UNKNOWN, which fails closed per gate laws.

dimensions.description: Every employer, date, title, credential, and metric must trace back to candidate_profile by exact id or deterministic match.
Output parses cleanly through ATS — standard sections, parseable dates, no rare unicode.
Output structure matches aos::apps_rg::resume_generation::v1 exactly — required sections present, ordered, field constraints met.
Hard guardrail — strict pass/fail. Any fabricated employer, date, credential, metric, or publication is an automatic fail.
Output respects length_preference — no padding, no redundant bullets.
dimensions.note: fail_closed_if_unknown=false per eval_rubrics — concision is capability class, not regression

dimensions.description: Resume language and emphasis align with target_role_spec (title, level, JD requirements, seniority signals).
Achievements use concrete metrics, scope, or outcomes where supported by profile evidence.

dimensions.grader_stub_note: QUARANTINED — raises RuntimeError on import. Stub only until W7.
dimensions.description: For senior+/exec target levels, summary and top bullets foreground scope, ownership, scale, outcomes. Informational only by default unless explicit policy activates gating.
dimensions.activation_policy: executive_positioning gating is OFF by default. Activate by setting informational_only=false in a future policy update once judge implementation is complete (W7).

enforcement_rules: Missing required deterministic grader (fail_closed_if_missing_grader=true) fails closed immediately
Missing required hybrid judge (fail_closed_if_missing_grader=true) fails closed immediately
Missing informational judge (fail_closed_if_missing_grader=false) does NOT hard fail — warns only
Judge timeout on required dimension treated as UNKNOWN — fails closed
Judge timeout on informational dimension logs a warning — does not fail
UNKNOWN verdict is never PASS regardless of dimension weight
executive_positioning informational_only=true by default — missing or UNKNOWN does not gate X3
